captions: Gate B12. 6:40. You prayed in a corner. Fast.
Three minutes. Eyes on the gate the whole time.
You refresh. You sigh. You stare. Forty minutes.
Beside you, an old man is still praying. Slowly. As if no one is waiting.
Noon. You've landed. Cold water. No rush this time.
Four rak'ahs of Dhuhr. You let every word land.
Seven minutes. The calmest part of your whole trip.

post.caption:
40 minutes staring at a delay. 3 minutes for Fajr. 🤍

We rush the one appointment that never gets cancelled — and wait patiently for everything else.

“Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.” (13:28)

Your next prayer is Dhuhr. Give it ten slow minutes.
